# `*` — Exponential / Exponent

`*Y`: e<sup>Y</sup>. Pervasive.

```apl
*0                ⍝ 1
```

`X*Y`: X<sup>Y</sup>. Integral powers of exact operands stay exact.

```apl
2*3               ⍝ 8
2x*¯3x            ⍝ 1r8
```

Other powers use principal complex branches where needed.

```apl
¯1*0.5            ⍝ 0j1
```

See also function [power `⍣`](power.qmd).
